text:
Job Title: Accounting & Tax Service Officer $450-$600
Company: LKNG Consulting Co., Ltd
Location: Street 317, Time Square II, 24th Floor, Toul Kork, Phnom Penh
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Level: Middle
Salary: Negotiable

Job Description & Responsibilities:
Accounting Services
• Liaise with clients to collect accounting records and supporting documents.
• Analyze accounting transactions and prepare accurate bookkeeping entries.
• Record accounting transactions using the double-entry accounting system.
• Prepare working papers and submit completed work for review.
• Review bookkeeping and accounting work prepared by junior team members and provide guidance where necessary.
• Maintain accounting records, cash books, and client files.
• Prepare Annual Accounting Record (ACAR) and other statutory reports.
• Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely completion of client assignments.
Tax Compliance Services
• Collect tax information and supporting documents from clients.
• Prepare monthly tax declarations.
• Submit completed tax returns for internal review by the Tax Advisor or Manager.
• Process tax declarations through the Cambodia e-Filing system.
• Prepare monthly tax payment schedules and supporting documentation.
• Prepare annual Tax on Income returns and other annual tax filings.
• Support and participate in tax audits.
• Attend meetings with tax authorities and represent the firm when assigned.
• Meet clients to explain tax matters, provide updates, and maintain professional relationships.
Client Relationship
• Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, calls, and emails.
• Provide timely follow-up on client requests.
• Build strong, long-term relationships through reliable and professional service.
• Attend client meetings independently or together with management when assigned.
Administration & Office Responsibilities
• Maintain both electronic and physical client files in an organized manner.
• Ensure confidentiality of all client information.
• Participate in internal training programs and professional development activities.
• Support office administration when required.
• Help maintain a clean, organized, and professional working environment.
• Participate in daily office housekeeping duties together with the team to ensure the workplace remains clean and welcoming.
• Perform other duties assigned by Management.
Working day	:  Mon-Sat (Sat half day)
Working Hour	:  8:00am to 5:30pm (break 12:00 to 1:30pm)
Salary range	:  $450-$600 (Based on qualifications and experiences)

Requirements & Qualifications:
Education
• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred.
Knowledge & Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of bookkeeping and double-entry accounting.
• Good knowledge of Cambodia Taxation.
• Familiarity with accounting software and Microsoft Office.
• Moderate English communication skills (written and spoken).
Experience
• Minimum 2–3 years of experience in accounting, tax compliance, and preferably from accounting firm.
• Experience handling multiple client accounts is preferred.
• Experience dealing with tax filings and tax authorities
Competencies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
• Comfortable working with numbers, calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.
• Ability to work independently while supporting team success.
• Good communication and client relationship skills.
• Willingness to learn, improve, and take on leadership responsibilities.
Personal Attributes
• High integrity and professional ethics.
• Positive attitude and strong sense of responsibility.
• Excellent interpersonal skills.
• Patient, dependable, and committed.
• Curious and eager to learn.
• Results-oriented with strong ownership.
• Team player who is willing to support colleagues.
• Humble and willing to contribute to both professional work and shared office responsibilities.
We value integrity, continuous learning, teamwork, and professional excellence. If you are looking for a workplace where your ideas, performance, and growth are recognized, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV to info@lkngconsulting.com
Office address: Street 317, Time Square II, 24th Floor, Toul Kork, Phnom Penh.
